titulo: Vitachy 2pcs Amber Glass Sprayer 500ml Silicone Base Spray Bottle Glass Bottle for Water Cleaning Hairstyle Pets Spray Atomizer Black and Chocolate
bullets: Contents: 2 x 500 ml amber glass sprayers with removable silicone base and pump with 2 spray modes and closure. Chalkboard labels and marker.
USES: Suitable for spraying any type of liquid based on water or oil. Useful for cleaning, gardening, ironing, hairdressing, pet care, etc.
2 spray modes: rotating the nozzle changes the spray mode: concentrate or diffuse atomization. A third mode closes the passage.
RESISTANT: Its silicone base prevents impact breakage and accidental drops due to its great adhesion to surfaces, even wet.
NO DRIPS: Unlike other glass sprayers, the head has a gasket that fits perfectly into the neck of the bottle, preventing any kind of dripping.
PRESENTATION: The product is delivered in a box with the sprayers protected by a bubble bag.
